exposure: Premature rupture of membranes (ROM) at ≥ 37 weeks of gestation
cohort: 520 women with ROM at ≥ 37 weeks of gestation
finding: In women with ROM at term and a Bishop score < 6, clinical leakage and cervical dilation ≥ 2 cm were the main predictors of labor onset within 24 hours, while a Bishop score ≥ 6 without labor onset was associated with a higher risk of low Apgar score and neonatal unit admission.
